about_the_game:
A 3D action game in which a high school girl goes on a rampage at school!

Blow away many classmates with combos!

Detect attacks with the sound of your headphones and parry!

Knock down the seniors with a lot of finishers!

There are seven different weapons you can use! Use them all to become the ruler of the school!
